targets.rawSql: SELECT dz.city, sum(fpo.line_amount) AS revenue FROM gold.fact_product_on_orders fpo JOIN gold.fact_purchase_orders fo ON fo.purchase_order_id = fpo.purchase_order_id JOIN gold.dim_delivery_zone dz ON dz.zone_id = fo.zone_id WHERE fpo.updated_at > now() - interval '24 hours' GROUP BY dz.city ORDER BY revenue DESC

panels.title: On-time delivery rate (avg time to destination, hours)

targets.rawSql: SELECT avg(time_to_destination_seconds) / 3600.0 AS avg_hours FROM gold.fact_shipments WHERE is_delivered

SELECT p.name, f.current_stock, f.nominal_capacity FROM gold.fact_inventory_snapshot f JOIN gold.dim_product p ON p.product_id = f.product_id AND p.dbt_valid_to IS NULL WHERE f.restock_required AND f.snapshot_date = current_date
